answer: The ledge I would price into every new account is Sapphire grader drilled bead assay witnessed by the gem hall: each drilled bead is a mine assay countersigned by the warden, so a farm must grade a hundred real sapphires by hand, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the tundra for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The nebula is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
